orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Sharad Kumar Sharma
orders.text:
WPSS No. 554 of 2020
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Rajesh Joshi, Advocate for the 
petitioners.
Mr. Vikas Pande, Standing Counsel for the 
State of Uttarakhand.
Notices on behalf of respondent Nos. 1, 2 
and 3 have been accepted by the learned Standing 
Counsel. Let notices be issued to respondent Nos. 
4 and 5. 
Steps to be taken within the period of ten 
days’ from today.
Respondents may file their counter 
affidavits within the period of three weeks from 
today.
The petitioners have challenged the 
impugned order of promotion dated 22.05.2020, 
promoting respondent Nos. 4 and 5; on the post of 
Superintendent (Gazetted).
The argument of the learned counsel for the 
petitions is that, respondent Nos. 4 and 5, who 
were initially working as CT Grade Teacher, later 
on, on account of same being declared as a dying 
cadre, as per the Government Order dated 
21.09.2005, their services had been merged in the 
LT Grade, and as a consequence of the merger in 
the LT Grade, the respondent Nos. 4 and 5, they 
had been drawing a higher scale with a grade pay 
of Rs. 4600/-.
Learned counsel for the petitioners further 
argues that in accordance with the Rule 6 of the 
Rules, called as “The Uttarakhand Tribes 
Welfare Gazetted Officer Services Rules, 2019”.
Under Rule 6 of the said Rules of 2019, 50 percent 
posts of the Superintendent (Gazetted); have to be 
filled through promotion, on the basis of seniority, 
from amongst the psychologists, substantially 
appointed and who have completed 5 years of 
service.
The grievance of the petitioners is that once 
the respondent Nos. 4 and 5 had already been  merged into LT Grade Teacher, and since they 
were drawing a higher grade pay of Grade Pay of 
Rs. 4600/-, they couldn’t have been promoted by 
the impugned order on the post of Superintendent 
(Gazetted), which is carrying a lower grade pay of 
Rs. 4200/-, because there cannot be a promotion of 
respondent Nos. 4 and 5 by down grading in their 
pay scale.
Learned counsel for the petitioners further 
submits that the respondents would not be entitled 
to be considered for promotion, because in 
accordance with Rule 6 of Rules, 2019, they do not 
fall to be within the feeding cadre, eligible for the 
promotion on the post of Superintendent 
(Gazetted), as per the said Rules of 2019.
In that view of the matter, apparently this 
Court is satisfied with the arguments, as extended 
by the learned counsel for the petitioners that the 
promotion granted to respondent Nos. 4 and 5 is by 
downgrading their pay scale, which cannot be done 
under the Rules of 2019, as well as the fact that 
they do not fall within the feeding cadre for 
promotion on the post of Superintendent 
(Gazetted), hence there would a stay of the order 
impugned dated 22.05.2020; till the next date of 
listing.
List this matter after three weeks.
Stay Application (CLMA No. 3770/2020) 
stands disposed of.
(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
 12.06.2020 Mahinder/

orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Lok Pal Singh
orders.text:
WPSS No. 554 of 2020
Hon’ble Lok Pal Singh, J.
Mr. Rajesh Joshi, Advocate for the 
petitioners.
Mr. P.C. Bisht, Standing Counsel for the 
State.
Mr. Rakesh Thapliyal, Senior Advocate 
for respondent nos. 4 & 5.
Stay Vacation Application No. 4444, 
5294 and 5347 of 2020 have been filed by 
the respondents.
Admit the writ petition. 
Misc. application IA No. 7120 of 2020 is 
allowed. Rejoinder affidavit is taken on 
record.
Heard learned counsel for the parties on 
the stay vacation application.
Learned counsel for the petitioners
would submit that respondent nos. 4 & 5 
have rightly been promoted on the post of 
Superintendent (Gazetted) vide promotion 
order dated 22.05.2020.
On the instructions received
telephonically, Mr. Rakesh Thapliyal, 
learned Senior Counsel appearing on behalf 
of the respondent nos. 4 & 5 would submit 
that pursuant to promotion order dated 
22.05.2020, respondent nos. 4 & 5 have 
joined their duties on promotional post on 
23.05.2020. Petitioners have filed this 
petition seeking writ in the nature of 
certiorari to quash the promotion order 
dated 22.05.2020. Since pursuant to the 
promotion order the respondent nos. 4 & 5 
have joined their duties, therefore
petitioners have filed this petition before this 
Court on 11.06.2020. 
This Court without having considered 
the facts that the petitioners are coming 
belatedly before the Court stayed the effect 
and operation of the promotion order vide 
order dated 12.06.2020. It is settled 
proposition of law that interim order should  not be in the nature of final relief. The relief 
sought by the petitioners is for quashing of 
the promotional order. There should be no
interim order on the stay of the promotion. 
Further more that the respondent nos. 4 & 5 
have already joined on the promotional post.
Accordingly, stay vacation applications 
are disposed of with the direction that the 
respondent nos.4 & 5, who have been 
promoted and joined on the post of 
Superintendent (Gazetted) shall continue to 
work on the said posts until further order of 
this Court. The order dated 12.06.2020 is 
modified to the extent as above.
List this case for final disposal in the 
month of October, 2020.
 (Lok Pal Singh, J.)
 10.08.2020
Nahid
